newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Tuesday amid a dearth of fundamental news, dealers said.
Prices are expected to creep lower ahead of the July contract's expiry on June 30. Friday's options expiry should accelerate liquidation of the front month, dealers said.
Monday, the July contract settled unchanged at 11.45 cents, having ranged from 11.47 to 11.37 cents. October closed up 0.05 to 11.31, and the remaining months finished 0.01 to 0.05 firmer.
Nearby support was pegged at Monday's low of 11.37 cents, where July has formed a double bottom.
An estimated 17,553 lots changed hands on the day.
LIFFE white sugar futures were trading barely lower in London, but the benchmark August contract held above support at $325.00. At 0845 EDT/1245 GMT, spot August stood $0.50 lower at $325.60.
